name: Supabase Open Graph social card by supabase.com
description: A 1200×630 dark card built on a single centered axis with almost no furniture: a near-black #1c1c1c canvas, the glyph-plus-wordmark lockup sitting in the upper third, and a stacked two-line headline filling the middle. The only hierarchy device is colour — line one of the headline is white while line two flips to the brand green (#3ECF8E), making the tagline pair read as a call-and-response. Roughly half the canvas is empty, which lets the heavy geometric sans headline dominate even at small preview sizes; there are no gradients, shadows, screenshots or decoration of any kind.
